labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: Concurrency
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, workload A, closed loop: each worker waits for its answer, so throughput rises with workers until the cluster saturates, and latency then grows instead.
